name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Business Operations & Analytics | SQL, BigQuery, Power BI, Project Management
summary: Business operations and analytics professional with 15+ years across e-commerce, MarTech, agency, and B2B SaaS, equally comfortable building the dashboard and running the process that gets it shipped. Writes SQL against BigQuery and GA4 data, builds Power BI data models and dashboards, and validates data flowing between CRMs, sites, and reporting tools. Gathers requirements from non-technical stakeholders, scopes the work, tracks timelines and blockers, and keeps everyone informed. Led a team of up to 20 at Wix and contributed to a 30% traffic and 25% conversion lift across the e-commerce segment.
